name: U.S. Virgin Islands
prevalence_note: The Virgin Islands Police Department has warned of a phone scam targeting senior citizens territorially, and US postal inspectors warn against fake USPS calls.
cross_border_note: The USVI (+1-340) are in the NANP, so mainland and spoofed +1 numbers look domestic.

scams.name: Phone scam targeting seniors
scams.name_en: Unsolicited official-sounding calls targeting USVI seniors, flagged by VIPD
scams.signals_en: Official-sounding callers target older residents with an urgent story that ends in a request for money or personal data.
scams.legit_en: VIPD has issued a territorial warning; check with police or family through a known number before acting.
bait_tactics: Ask which VIPD station is calling, St Thomas or St Croix, and the officer's badge number
Say a grandchild handles all calls about money
